# `csharp_indent_case_contents`

Indent statements inside a case label.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

### `csharp_indent_case_contents = true`

```ini
csharp_indent_case_contents = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Name(int code)
    {
        switch (code)
        {
            case 1:
            return "one";
            case 2:
            {
            var msg = "two";
            return msg;
            }
            default:
            return "other";
        }
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Name(int code)
    {
        switch (code)
        {
            case 1:
                return "one";
            case 2:
                {
                    var msg = "two";
                    return msg;
                }
            default:
                return "other";
        }
    }
}
```
:::

::::
